label: Doc maintenance (coding agent, 30 min)
description: Git ff-only pull, then documentation gaps in this workspace. Wähle unten den Project-Workspace im Dropdown. Worker muss unter Admin → Interfaces aktiv sein. Job startet disabled — nach Workspace-Auswahl auf Enabled stellen.

job.title: Doc maintenance
job.instructions:
Scheduled documentation maintenance for THIS workspace only.

## Phase 0 — Git (required first)
1. coding_git_read: inspect git status.
2. If working tree is NOT clean and current branch is NOT named agent/*: append reason to docs/MAINTENANCE_REPORT.md and STOP (no pull, no doc edits).
3. coding_git_sync with operation pull (fast-forward only). On failure: log to docs/MAINTENANCE_REPORT.md and STOP.
4. Create or checkout branch agent/doc-MAINT (use today's date in branch name via coding_bash). Do not commit on main/master.

## Phase 1 — Inventory (read-only)
1. Read docs/CONVENTIONS.md if it exists.
2. Survey docs/** and README; list up to 5 highest-impact documentation gaps.
3. Append Inventory section to docs/MAINTENANCE_REPORT.md.

## Phase 2 — Edits (limits)
- Fix at most 3 gaps from the inventory.
- Touch at most 8 files total.
- Only docs/ and root README.md.
- No src/tests refactors, no dependency bumps, no git push.

## Phase 3 — Close
1. Run coding_workspace_verify if configured for this workspace.
2. Append Done or Blocked summary to docs/MAINTENANCE_REPORT.md.
3. Reply with a short plain-text summary (branch, files changed, verify result).

coding_workflow.prompt_preamble: Conservative scheduled doc maintenance. Prefer small, accurate doc edits. Stop early if git pull fails or tree is dirty.
